summary: Repeated failures reach Invardia as one clear report instead of stalling.

fixes.title: Repeated failures reported once
fixes.text: A job that fails three runs in a row is reported to Invardia as one repeated failure, and Invardia opens a fix request. A missing permission stays a step for you.

fixes.title: Reports to Invardia no longer get stuck
fixes.text: One refused record no longer holds back the reports of other jobs, and it is skipped after three refusals.
